question: Which of the following is an example of impairment to an internal auditor’s independence? A. Due to his prior position as the accounts payable supervisor for two years, a new member of the internal audit function is assigned to audit accounts payable. B. An internal auditor delays reporting her findings to management until after a friend transfers from the department under review. C. The senior internal auditor utilizes the chief financial officer’s recommended sample selections to perform detailed testing. D. Believing there must be errors in a given balance sheet account, the internal auditor decides to expand her testing.
